# T-1: Extend retro code eligibility

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Broaden the shared retro eligibility predicate so tracked production JavaScript files under a detected top-level `src/` source root are code-eligible while existing eligible paths remain unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `src/flow/lib/example.js` is eligible only when it is safe, Git-tracked, and production JavaScript.
- `lib/`, `commands/`, `hooks/`, and root plugin/config paths remain eligible.

## Implementation Notes
Keep the bounded metadata input to the tracked file set loaded by `loadTrackedFiles`. A helper or class may encapsulate source-root metadata if it improves invariants, but it must stay deterministic from repository-relative tracked paths.

## Test Strategy
Unit or spec-local tests construct tracked path sets and candidates for `src/` and legacy eligible paths.
